name: Masterpiece
long_description:
We believe AI will be one of humanity’s next great masterpieces. Building it will require financial infrastructure as ambitious as the companies creating it. We're founders backed by Y Combinator building the financial rails underpinning the AI data economy.

Masterpiece provides short term working capital to data vendors that sell training data, evaluation work, and reinforcement learning environments to frontier AI labs.

A major financing gap exists in this market. Data vendors often need to pay contributors and fund operations before a lab has completed QA, accepted the work, and paid the invoice. This creates a 30 to 90 day cash gap between when vendors incur costs and when they receive payment. Legacy invoice lenders have little visibility into how to underwrite these assets.

Masterpiece closes that gap by advancing capital against high quality lab contracts and invoices. Vendors can use the capital to scale delivery, pay contributors, and fund growth, then repay masterpiece when the lab payment arrives.

launches.body:
**TLDR:** Masterpiece finances the AI data economy. We provide short-duration, invoice-backed loans to AI data vendors while their work is in QA review and they wait through Net 30–90 payment terms. We advance capital against expected payments from frontier labs, giving vendors the working capital to keep operating and producing data for the frontier labs.

Launch Video: <https://youtu.be/aol__HmDbYY>

**Problem**

For AI data vendors, financing frontier AI demand is broken:

* Vendors front the costs: They pay contributors and fund delivery before labs finish QA, accept the work, and pay.
* Cash is locked up for 30–90 days: QA reviews and payment terms create a major working-capital gap just as vendors need cash to take on more work.
* Legacy lenders don’t understand AI data: Traditional invoice lenders lack the context to underwrite QA status, lab counterparties, and data contracts properly.
* Existing financing is slow and expensive: When capital is available, underwriting can take weeks and come with high fees, making it poorly suited to fast-moving AI data businesses.

**How we solve it**

Masterpiece closes the 30–90 day cash gap by advancing capital against high quality lab contracts and invoices. We underwrite AI data vendors based on their invoices, payment history, data quality, and financials, allowing qualified vendors to access working capital in 2–4 days instead of weeks. 

We power these loans through two scalable sources of liquidity: **institutional credit and our stablecoin, $USDml.** Private credit funds and banks provide dedicated lending capital, while $USDml creates a crypto native liquidity pool where users stake stablecoins to fund Masterpiece loans and our haircut capital requirements to earn a target 8–12% yield from the interest generated.

**Traction** 

**In 3 weeks, we’ve:**

* **Closed a $10m+ warehouse lending facility from an institutional credit fund**
* **$65m+ in signed LOIs from some of the top data vendors and RL environment**
* **$200k in loans earning 24% APY**

**Who we are**

* **Benjamin Nguyen (CEO):** B.S Operations Research at Columbia University. 2x founder. Previously COO at Absinthe Labs, where he helped scale the company to 50+ enterprise customers across the crypto ecosystem and led go to market, partnerships, customer success, and operations.
* **Vivek Yanamadula (CTO**): BA, Mathematics @ Columbia University. MA Computer Science @ Columbia University. Previously full stack engineer at Amazon on the AWS marketing team. Published researcher in Quantum and AI computing at IEEE QCE under Dr. Ronghui Gu, CertiK founder.

**Ask**

If you're a data vendor in need of financing against your invoices and datasets, we’d love to talk.

Feel free to email me at [ben@masterpiecelabs.xyz](mailto:ben@masterpiecelabs.xyz) or book a time here: <https://calendly.com/ben-masterpiece/30min>
